240-5470-6633-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-5470-6633-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

631-3899-6249--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

443-2738-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-1308-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-2557-4094-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
1308-2557-4094-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1739-1895-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5542-6144-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6144-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6144-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1878-2634-5195-7735.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-2634-5195-7735.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-2634-5195-7735.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

1479-2841-6155-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6155-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2113-3711-4222.description:
Activate Moonfolk Puzzlemaker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Moonfolk Puzzlemaker triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Moonfolk Puzzlemaker.
Repeat.

1309-2104-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-6596.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
1618-2440-3019-6596.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-6596.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

628-5147-7212.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3875-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3875-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3661-4050-4763--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere, adding {R}.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-2921-3505.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

5256-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2173-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

645-1267-5147-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5147-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

431-851-3129-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-3129-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

934-1238-2351-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

632-3621-4359-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-3621-4359-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2457-4094-4289-4785.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-4785.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

997-2105-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
997-2105-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-4484-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4050-4484-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

4050-5394-6291.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-4050-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {B}.
When Jumblebones dies, it triggers, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1737-2793-2921.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat each turn.

813-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting  Scholar of the Ages
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Scholar of the Ages
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux and up to one other instant or sorcery to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2511-5551-5552.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2511-5551-5552.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Kaslem that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

275-1799-2034-3862.notablePrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
275-1799-2034-3862.description:
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Orcish Bowmasters into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Army and Orcish Bowmasters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

4067-4289-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
4067-4289-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

1095-2247-3516-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Teferi has at least seven loyalty counters on it.
Ajani Steadfast has at least three loyalty counters on it.
1095-2247-3516-4772.description:
Activate Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani, the Greathearted's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Ajani Steadfast's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Ajani, the Greathearted's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, and two loyalty counters on each other planeswalker you control.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing you to loot.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

1322-3129-3304-4289-4963.description:
On your upkeep, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}.
On your draw step, create two Bear tokens.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping itself, adding one mana of any color.
Activate World of Wilding by paying {2}.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing a Bear token, creating four Bear tokens and discarding three cards.
Activate two Bear tokens by tapping those, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat from step 4.

864-3742-4377.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
864-3742-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness that is tapped and attacking.
Eternal Witness enters, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2853-3096.description:
Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library, preventing the next one damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Repeat until there are zero cards remaining in your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on him, milling target player for two and winning you the game.
